ABOUT

About Me

Making AI useful, responsible and practical in the real world.

My Story

I’ve spent most of my career in businesses where processes, data and how decisions get made really matter.

Over the last five years, I’ve focused on AI and automation strategy, maturity assessment, use-case prioritisation, ROI modelling and responsible AI governance, helping leadership teams move from ad-hoc experiments to structured adoption.

I’m not selling a specific tool or platform. My strength is understanding the business problem, asking the right questions, spotting risks, structuring the process and helping people feel confident using the solution.

For me, successful AI adoption is not about buying the latest tool and hoping for the best. It is about:

  • Understanding the real problem
  • Deciding whether AI is actually the right answer
  • Putting the right controls in place
  • Involving the people affected by the change
  • Measuring whether it delivers real value

Recent work includes RxField, a production field-force app for a pharmaceutical SME (React Native, TypeScript, Supabase) replacing manual sales tracking across a three-tier manager hierarchy, and an end-to-end automation programme for a hospitality client across 50 properties.

I hold valid work authorisation and I’m open to roles in AI adoption, business transformation, process improvement and responsible AI.

EXPERIENCE

Track Record

A timeline of roles and results.

Freelance AI & Automation Consultant

Independent · May 2026 – Present

Since leaving Everest Group, I’ve taken on independent AI and automation engagements alongside strategy advisory work.

For a pharmaceutical SME client, I designed and built RxField, a production field-force management app (React Native, TypeScript, Supabase) replacing manual and spreadsheet-based tracking for a sales team and its full reporting chain. It automates:

  • Visit logging, tour planning, and deviation tracking against actuals
  • Order capture and verification
  • Auto-drafted expense claims
  • Coverage tracking across a 3-tier manager hierarchy

Every data boundary is enforced at the database layer via Postgres row-level security, rather than client-side checks.

In Closed Testing — Pre-Launch on Google Play

Practice Director — Data, Automation & AI

Everest Group · Feb 2023 – May 2026

I advised global enterprises and technology providers on where AI genuinely creates value: which use cases to prioritise, which vendors to trust, and when to build versus buy. And I didn’t stop at advice. I ran consulting engagements end to end, building the roadmaps and ROI models clients acted on.

I also co-led our Agentic Process Automation (APA) programme and took a process-mining provider’s agentic AI product from architecture to preview launch. That kept me close to where agentic AI is actually heading, not where the hype says it is.

  • Delivered across financial services, manufacturing, payments, and private equity (see Case Studies below for the numbers)
  • Designed the Total Value Assessment framework, now a reusable standard across 10+ enterprise clients
  • Grew and mentored a high-performing analyst team, cutting time-to-promotion from 2.5 to ~1.5 years
